title: Mobile phone with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x="28" y="8" width="44" height="84" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#3a6ea5"/>
  <!-- lighter edge for definition -->
  <rect x="30" y="10" width="40" height="80" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#4a8ec9"/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x="35" y="20" width="30" height="52" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#1a2a3a"/>
  <!-- screen glow border -->
  <rect x="35" y="20" width="30" height="52" rx="3" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#5ab0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- smiling eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="3" fill="#f7d74b"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="38" r="3" fill="#f7d74b"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="37" r="1" fill="#fff8d0"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="37" r="1" fill="#fff8d0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q50 60 58 50" fill="none" stroke="#f7d74b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="4" fill="#2a5a8a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="3" fill="#5ab0e8"/>
  <!-- speaker slot -->
  <rect x="44" y="13" width="12" height="2" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#2a5a8a"/>
  <!-- cheek blushes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="47" r="3" fill="#e87a7a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="47" r="3" fill="#e87a7a" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
